products.description:
When you wanna look as comfortable as you feel, it's gotta be the Jordan Trunner O/S "Iced Carmine/Reflect Silver/Phantom" Women's Shoe. This modern take on the original Jordan Trunner features breathable mesh and suede that keeps the upper flexible, while responsive foam underfoot gives you a soft step, every step.
  • Plush tongue and collar give you padded comfort and an easy on/off.
  • Molded plastic support wings give you midfoot containment for a sturdy feel.
